Independent eyecare in the heart of Walthamstow

Established in 1982, Wood Street Opticians is one of the oldest independent practices in Walthamstow. With over 40 years of experience serving the community. We provide a holistic approach to eyecare and strive for excellent eyecare.

Book Online

Regular eye examinations are essential for clear vision and long-term eye health. We provide thorough eye tests for both NHS and private patients, using modern equipment and easy-to-understand explanations.

OCT (Optical Coherence Tomography) allows us to look in more detail at the health of your eyes and can help detect problems such as age-related macular degeneration, glaucoma and diabetes to name a few, earlier.

We stock a wide range of eyewear to suit all styles and price points. Whether you’re looking for something simple and practical or bold and distinctive, we’ll help you choose frames that feel right for you.
